title: Canonical constant-coefficient scalar extension, direct image and pullback comparison
statement: Let $A,B$ be arbitrary commutative rings of universe $u$, let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism, and let $f:T\to V$ be a morphism of schemes of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small pro-etale sites and constant ring sheaves with their canonical constant-section inverse-image identifications [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Write $D(W,A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category. Define $S_W:D(W,A)\to D(W,B)$ to be the universal derived extension of scalars along the actual constant-ring map $A_W\to B_W$, using the ringed scalar-extension construction [def-weil-pbc-four-corners]. Define $Rf_*^A:D(T,A)\to D(V,A)$ to be the ordinary uncompleted ringed derived direct image whose scalar action is through the adjoint of the canonical constant-section comparison, and write $f_A^*:D(V,A)\to D(T,A)$ for the exact derived identified-coefficient inverse image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define the natural isomorphism $\lambda_f:f_B^*S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Tf_A^*$ to be the canonical ringed reduction/pullback isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], specialized to the constant rings, the two actual constant-ring maps induced by $\varphi$, and the canonical constant-section coefficient identifications. Its coefficient square is the naturality square of those identifications. Equivalently it is the inverse mate of the exact restriction/pullback comparison, normalized on K-flat representatives by the ordinary tensor balancing map. No finiteness, flatness, boundedness, constructibility, properness or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed.

def directImageScalarPullbackIso {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {T V : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ V) :
    directImageScalarExtension φ V ⋙ Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B f ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f ⋙ directImageScalarExtension φ T
